summary: Senior product manager with payments domain experience at Starling Bank and Revolut, including a 34% cut in settlement failures on Faster Payments integration and an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes. Leads cross-functional teams of engineers and designers, with a BSc in Computer Science and SQL skills supporting close technical partnership with engineering.
